## 2026-04-27 — Market-Open Execution Log (post-fact reconciliation)
### What happened
A separate market-open agent ran on a fresh local clone that did NOT include the Apr 23-27 prior research entries above. Without seeing the binding pre-market plan, that agent ran its own Perplexity research and decided NVDA / MSFT / PLTR alpha entries instead of the planned INTC entry. Orders filled at the open before the git push surfaced the conflict and the agent fetched the existing plan.

### Reconciliation (executed in same session)
- **MSFT — REVERSED.** Closed 3 sh ~$420.90 vs $420.23 entry, ~+$2 round-trip. Two violations: (a) MSFT reports AMC Wed = binary event-risk explicitly to be avoided per Saturday research; (b) cost basis $1,261 = 12.6% > 10% event-week sizing cap.
- **NVDA — KEPT.** $1,049 = 10.49% (micro-overage vs 10% cap, $49). Not reporting this week. Trail stop $189.07 GTC live. Saturday research had NVDA as "neutral, wait for Wed prints" — kept entry rather than churn another PDT slot.
- **PLTR — KEPT.** $1,006 = 10.06% (micro-overage vs 10% cap, $6). Not reporting this week. Trail stop $129.92 GTC live.
- Did not trim NVDA/PLTR partials — daytrade_count is now 3/5 after MSFT close, at PDT margin.

### Lessons logged
1. ALWAYS `git fetch && git pull` BEFORE first trade decisions on a new clone. The pre-market research artifact is the binding plan.
2. Event-risk weeks (FOMC + mega-cap earnings) require strict 10% sizing — round share counts can push slightly over.
3. INTC was the planned setup but never executed today; revisit pullback-entry plan tomorrow if levels hold.

**TRADE-biased on confirmed AMD setup, otherwise HOLD** — Wednesday with AMD blowout AMC + DIS BMO beat + ADP 7:15 AM PST + ARM AMC tonight is a tape-rich session with one clear catalyst-driven entry candidate (AMD post-earnings drift). **Plan for market-open agent**:

4. **AMZN — TIER 2 backup.** Same Plan B mechanics as AMD; only enter if AMD setup fails AND AMZN confirms independently. Otherwise SKIP, revisit Thu.
5. **PLTR trail handling** — let the trail at $134.66 do the work; manual cut at $133.67 (-7% from entry) if breached. **No pre-emptive trim** — sell-the-news on a blowout is not a thesis break by itself.
6. **AVOID ARM pre-print, INTC, META, AVGO, MRVL, TSM, ASML, SMCI, MU, QCOM, DIS, MSFT** — no clean setup or out of theme.
7. **Niche sleeve stays empty** — no 2.5:1 R:R idea today.
8. **Save trade slots for:** (a) AMD if it confirms today, (b) AMZN if AMD fails, (c) ARM post-print drift Thu if beat+raise.

Bias toward TRADE — AMD is the cleanest post-earnings drift catalyst we've seen since GOOGL on 4/30, and the alpha sleeve is materially under-deployed. ### ⚠️ Memory-integrity failure found and repaired (STEP 0, before any market work)
The broker showed **ADI in the book** and **RKLB at 13 shares** while the committed log ended at **8/14 pre-market**. Cause: **`157b0bc`, today's market-open log, was committed to `origin/claude/nifty-pascal-65c4iw` and never merged to `main`.** `origin/main` itself was fine — 8/14 midday, 8/14 EOD, the Week 17 review and today's pre-market had all landed; local `main` was simply stale, and one commit was orphaned.

**Control added to the standing triggers:** every routine must (a) scan for branches ahead of `main` at STEP 1 and (b) verify `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` is **0** after pushing. A commit on a feature branch is invisible to every other agent and is functionally lost.

### 🔴 FREEZE-DATE CORRECTION — "re-test 8/26" is unreachable as written
The 8/24 EOD entry carries the freeze as **"SEMI-FREEZE HOLDS UNTIL 8/26 · Re-test 8/26 after NVDA."** **That date cannot be executed.**
- **NVDA reports 8/26 AMC — after the close.** Every 8/26 routine (pre-market ~05:30, market-open ~06:30, midday ~09:20, EOD ~13:15 PT) runs **before** the print. **There is no routine on 8/26 that can re-test "after NVDA."**
- **Corrected expiry: the freeze runs through the 8/26 close and the FIRST routine that can re-test it is Thu 8/27 pre-market.**
- **Why this is worth a correction and not a shrug:** a rule whose stated date is unreachable gets fudged by whichever routine arrives at it — either a session buys a semi on 8/26 claiming the freeze "expired today," or the freeze silently drifts with no dated end. The 8/21 ratification exists precisely because an undated discretionary block is how a cap becomes permanent by accident.
- **The 8/21 requirement still applies at the re-test: any extension past 8/27 needs its own stated trigger and its own lapse date.**

### ⭐ FINDING FOR THE WEEKLY REVIEW — the R:R gate does not gate
**This is not proposed on one session's evidence. It has two dated stop-outs behind it.**
- **8/21 pre-market armed RKLB at 7.01:1** (this log, Week 18 Day 5) off the **$110.65** 22-analyst average, and queued **BUY 5 RKLB LIMIT $77.00**. It filled at $74.55.
- That lot **stopped out**. The 8/24 replacement lot **hard-stopped at $69.31 for −7.03%**.
- Across that entire window the chart made **six consecutive lower closes**. **Point 6 was documented in every one of those entries and gated none of them.**
- **The mechanism of the failure:** the R:R ratio is computed against an analyst average sitting **58% above spot**. Solving the 2.5:1 floor for RKLB gives a ceiling of **$94.17** — **34% above the current price.** A gate that only binds 34% above the market is not a gate. It passed at $77, it passes at $70, and it would pass on the way to $58.
- ⭐ **PROPOSAL for Fri 8/28: make point 6 a GATE, not a note. No niche entry into a name printing lower highs AND lower lows on 3+ consecutive sessions, regardless of R:R.** Today's RKLB rejection is the first application, made in advance of the rule rather than after it.
- ⚠️ **Counter-argument, recorded so the review sees both sides:** this rule would also have blocked the ASTS entry on 8/24 (which is **−2.09%**, i.e. it has not been vindicated either) and it will mechanically block dip-buying into strong names. **The review should weigh it against the alternative reading — that a 10% trail on a 6%-daily-range name is the actual defect, which is already P0 from the MRVL give-back.**
